answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: each identity's rewards sit on a ledge for 30 epochs before becoming spendable, and if peer review later shows an account was a hollow copy of another, its locked balance is clawed back. An attacker running a thousand fake agents must pay compute for every one through the whole lock window while risking total forfeiture, so each forged quill-stroke of output costs real money with no quick payout.
